cohort: Patients who underwent Cesarean delivery in the USA in 2020
finding: Cesarean delivery patients with COVID-19 had a 30-fold higher mortality rate compared to those without COVID-19, with Hispanic and Medicaid patients disproportionately impacted.
mod_finding: The study found that Cesarean delivery patients with COVID-19 had a 30-fold higher mortality rate compared to those without COVID-19.
